.. py:data:: _SUBSET_TASKS

.. py:class:: TotalSegRoiWidget(parent: qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget | None = None)

   Bases: :py:obj:`qtpy.QtWidgets.QGroupBox`


   Checkbox list of ROI names for a TotalSegmentator subset task (``total``/``total_mr``), with
   All/None select buttons; hidden for tasks that don't support ROI subsetting.


   .. py:attribute:: _checks
      :type:  list[qtpy.QtWidgets.QCheckBox]
      :value: []



   .. py:attribute:: _btn_all


   .. py:attribute:: _btn_none


   .. py:attribute:: _scroll


   .. py:attribute:: _inner


   .. py:attribute:: _inner_layout


   .. py:method:: available_tasks() -> tuple[str, Ellipsis]
      :staticmethod:


      Every registered TotalSegmentator task name.



   .. py:method:: set_task(task: str) -> None

      Rebuild the checkbox list for *task*'s ROI class map, hiding this widget entirely for
      tasks that don't support ROI subsetting.



   .. py:method:: select_all() -> None

      Check every ROI checkbox.



   .. py:method:: select_none() -> None

      Uncheck every ROI checkbox.



   .. py:method:: selected_roi_names() -> list[str] | None

      Names of the checked ROIs, or ``None`` if none are checked (meaning "all ROIs").
